summary: The package's front door: `__init__.py` marks the `iip/` folder as a regular Python package and runs once, the first time anything inside `iip` is imported. It holds the project's one-paragraph description and the single version string that `app.py` (API docs) and `routes/system.py` (health endpoint) report.

notes.text: Opening line of the package docstring, naming the project. A docstring is a string literal placed first in a module; Python keeps it in `__doc__`, and because this file stands for the package itself, it describes `iip` as a whole.

The elevator pitch: the stages an event flows through, in order, plus the reminder that all data is synthetic. Each arrow maps to code you will meet later: ingestion in `routes/events.py`, normalization in `pipeline.py`, geo enrichment in `geo.py`, scoring in `rules.py`, correlation in `correlation.py`, the live stream in `live.py` (feeding the `web/` dashboard) and the analyst in `analyst.py`.

`__version__` is the conventional attribute name for a package's version. `app.py` passes it to FastAPI (it appears on the `/docs` page) and the health endpoint in `routes/system.py` reports it; `pyproject.toml` repeats "2.0.0" by hand, so the two must be bumped together.
